scope_note: This is Popper's falsifiability-based demarcation criticism. Recording it does not settle later disputes about whether particular psychoanalytic hypotheses can be operationalized and tested.
statement: Popper argued that apparent clinical confirmations were insufficient unless analysts specified in advance which observations would count as refutations.
statement_zh: Popper 主張，若分析者沒有事先說明哪些觀察結果構成反駁，臨床上的表面確認就不足以成為真正的檢驗。
